correctness.rationale: All frozen permutation and word-program artifacts were materialized by exact Git blob and SHA256. An independent GAP 4.12.1/CTblLib replay recomputes every (2,3,7) character sum, normalized constant and class multiplication coefficient in all three groups. It exhausts all 4599 involutions against a representative of each of all eleven order-seven classes. The six empty classes, two 49-pair classes and three 105-pair classes match exactly; every generated subgroup order and every exact maximal-conjugacy/containment claim is checked. All 315 order-504 generated subgroups are explicitly isomorphic to PSL(2,8). The 73 conjugates of each named parabolic give exactly 56 matches each and union 105 per positive class. Both extension representations and ATLAS word-program normal subgroups are rebuilt, with exact orders and indices three/two. Quotient coprimality proves trapping without probabilistic sampling.
residual_risks: Exact finite computation relies on GAP, CTblLib and the checked frozen representations; it is not a formal proof-assistant or expert certificate.
